All five deliverables are done, tested (`provider.test.mjs` 6/6 passing with no key), and reported to the parent mastermind with the spike table. Nothing further to do on this brief — the parent task owns merging.

Both follow-ups are done, verified, committed, and reported:

**1. Gemini 400 — found and fixed:** the offending tool was the built-in `ArtifactData` (not one of ours) — its `query.where` param is an array of `[field, op, value]` tuples that declares `prefixItems` but no `items` on the inner array, which Gemini's strict validator rejects before any tool call. Dropped it for `google/*` models via a new `disallowed_tools_for(model)` in `provider.js`, wired into both `spike.mjs` and `Agents.js`. Reran the spike on both Gemini models — the 400 is gone:

| model | tools | stream | edit | resume ok | $real |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview | 0 | true | false | true | $0.0108 |
| google/gemini-3.8-flash | 3 | true | true | true | $0.0714 |

`gemini-3.8-flash` fully passed; `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` hit one separate transient stream error (not the schema bug) — flagged to the mastermind rather than chased further.

**2. Cost bug — fixed:** `refresh_or_cost()` was overwriting `this.cost` with each turn's delta instead of accumulating; now keeps a running `or_cost`. `result()`/`compact_done()` no longer let `total_cost_usd` touch cost for an openrouter agent. Documented the shared-key mis-attribution caveat as asked.

Committed in `f67d73af` (code) and `c923ec59` (log), test suite 7/7, and the full table reported back to `task-mastermind-openrouter`.

Phase 2 item 1 (the spend guard) is done and reported. Summary:

- **Cap**: `Agents.spawn()` refuses an OpenRouter spawn (one clear line) once today's spend hits `SERVEX_OR_DAILY_CAP` (default $8) or credit drops under $1 — checked via a lazily-started 30s cache so it never adds a network call to the hot path or to unrelated test imports, and fails closed if it can't read the key.
- **Ledger**: every settled turn appends one line to the `openrouter` log through Servex's single-writer `Log`, no second writer.
- **Dashboard**: one more bar in the existing `usage_rail()` meter (same component the Claude 5h/weekly windows use), with credit-left in the label — no new widget.

Commits `836d93f5` (code) and `bab5a0bb` (log), `provider.test.mjs` at 12/12. Left `Servex/ext/openrouter/evals/` untouched for the other minion, and flagged (with a verified false-positive note) a health-check hook that fired twice on an unrelated, pre-existing `usage.json` 404. Haiku's one fail is real: on rung 4 (plan-views) it wrote `architecture.md` with three options but never actually called `decide.mjs` — a genuine capability gap, not a harness bug.

**Agreement:** too little OpenRouter data yet to compute real strong-set agreement (only one gpt-6-sol run exists, on h1-page, where it agreed with all three Claude models — PASS). The rest of the OpenRouter strong/cheap set is queued for after the 00:00 UTC reset.

**Harness failures found + fixed (all "c"), no re-spend needed on 2 of 3:**
1. `checksH1` grabbed the page's auto-rendered title instead of checking every h1 — was false-failing correct Opus/Sonnet runs. Fixed.
2. Servex's 5-agent concurrency queue returned a real id with `queued:true`, read as instantly "complete" — produced 3 fake identical-cost rows. Fixed with a real-turn poller.
3. `checksDecision` only read `task.jsonl`, but `decide.mjs`'s own doc example targets `page.jsonl` — no single canonical name. Scanned every `.jsonl` in the run dir instead; reconciled the 3 affected plan-views rows straight from existing run output, no re-spawn.
4. `runs/ui-fouls/<id>/` needed its own placeholder `page.js` (two path segments under `runs/`, same trap as the original `runs/page.js` fix, one level deeper) — first screenshots were all the site's 404 page. Fixed before any model was scored on it.

**ui-fouls (vision rung) — Opus benchmark:** 3/3 planted fouls found (zero padding, 400px overflow, low contrast), no invented fouls. Cheap vision-capable models queued for after the reset.

**Web-search check (gaps.md #1):** WebSearch/WebFetch on a proxied OpenRouter minion never reach Anthropic — both test models (deepseek-v4.1-flash, gpt-6-luna) ran with every Anthropic credential blanked (env vars + empty `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`) and produced zero `claude-*` generations. Recommendation: no separate search tool needed, ~$0.002–0.007/search.

**Queued for after 00:00 UTC** ($1.50/day budget): strong pair (gpt-6-sol, gemini-3.1-pro-preview) only where Opus/Sonnet disagree (none found yet); the cheap set + two cheapest-tool-capable models on rungs 1–2; cheap vision-capable models on ui-fouls.
